title: BioPedic Eco-Classic pillow 4 set
text: BioPedic Eco-Classic pillow 4 set. Bought grandsons 2 sets of bunk beds and they needed pillows for all those beds!  This is a great set of pillows.  My daughter reports that the pillows arrived quickly (I have prime) and in good condition.  It's nice that Amazon makes it easy to help my daughter with just about anything.  She reports the pillows are of good quality and should last a reasonable amount of time.  I always update my reviews if new info would be helpful.  Also, I do NOT receive compensation for my reviews, ever.

product_metadata.title: BioPedic fiber Eco-Classic 250-Thread Count Standard Pillows (Pack of 4), White
features: RECYCLED POLYESTER FIBER FILL- Each pillow is generously filled with recycled polyester fiber to offer lofty support
HYPOALLERGENIC FIBER- The naturally hypoallergenic fiber helps keep your sleeping area fresh & clean
LUXURY 250 THREAD COUNT COTTON COVER- The eco-friendly, all natural cotton cover adds a layer of smooth softness
GREAT FOR ALL SLEEP POSITIONS- The fiberfill cradles the head to offer plush comfort ideal for all sleep styles
MACHINE WASHABLE- Each of these Eco-Classic pillows can be machine washed for lasting freshness
4-Pack of Eco-Classic Standard Pillows; These standard pillows measure 20-inch by 26-inch
description: The BioPEDIC Eco Classic standard pillow 4 Pack is the perfect pack for those seeking value and comfort. Each pillow features a 250 thread count cover made from all natural, cotton and is generously filled with lofty recycled fiber providing excellent support and comfort. All pillows are hypoallergenic and are machine washable for lasting freshness.
